scripts.build:cli: npm run build:scanner && npm run build -w packages/cli
scripts.build:vscode: npm run build:scanner && npm run vscode:prepublish -w packages/vscode-extension
scripts.build:artifacts: npm run build:cli && npm run build -w packages/mcp-server && npm run build:action && npm run build:vscode
scripts.pack:release: npm pack -w packages/scanner-core -w packages/cli --dry-run && npm run package:vsix -w packages/vscode-extension
scripts.scan:self: npm run build:cli && ASSURLY_DOGFOOD_MAX_BLOCKERS=2 node packages/cli/dist/index.js scan -p .
